d: Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.

The HSE Engineer is responsible for implementing, monitoring, and maintaining Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) standards across project construction activities, ensuring compliance with company policies, client requirements, and applicable regulations.
q: Bachelor's degree or Diploma in HSE, Engineering, or a related discipline.
NEBOSH Certificate or equivalent HSE qualification.
Minimum 7 years of relevant HSE experience, preferably within construction or EPC projects.
Previous exposure to Wind, Solar PV, Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), and/or substation construction safety.
Good knowledge of construction safety regulations, risk assessments, and HSE management systems.
Strong communication, reporting, and site coordination skills.

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. r: Implement and monitor project HSE plans, procedures, and safety requirements.
Conduct regular site inspections, safety audits, and risk assessments to identify and mitigate potential hazards.
Ensure safe execution of construction activities, including Wind, Solar PV, Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), and/or substation projects.
Monitor compliance with HSE legislation, industry standards, and client requirements.
Conduct toolbox talks, safety inductions, and HSE awareness training for project personnel and contractors.
Investigate incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions, recommending corrective and preventive actions.
Monitor contractor HSE performance and ensure implementation of appropriate safety controls.
Maintain HSE records, reports, inspection findings, and incident documentation.
Promote a proactive safety culture and continuous improvement across project activities.
